logical_page_cycle_interpretation: Adding justified_by produces three contextual page SCCs already present before this proposal (different items on a pair of pages can justify each other without an item cycle). Current native pageSucc intentionally uses deps, while logical justified_by is checked at item level. None is introduced by proposed requires; no same-ID relocation is necessary for these77 undeclared-deps failures. The full observation retains them instead of claiming the logical page union is acyclic.
justified_by_cycle_semantics: Raw justified_by is a verification/phase relation, not an ordinary prerequisite edge; this metadata task makes no raw-union item-cycle claim. Current native phase-contract checks remain authoritative.
